svg.title: prepare shapes
svg.text: _prepare: positions → block table → slots in the paged cache
a 40-token prefill: table.append_tokens(40) takes ⌈40/16⌉ = 3 blocks; slot = block_id · 16 + offset
positions 0 … 39 of the request, cut into logical blocks of 16
allocator free list (pop from the end)
paged cache, one layer: [4096 blocks, 16 slots, 8 heads, 64] (16 of the 4096 blocks drawn)
slot_mapping: [40], one flat slot index per position (block_id · 16 + offset)
Positions stay 0 … 39 (RoPE uses them); the slots jump between scattered physical blocks.
Within one block, consecutive positions take consecutive slots; across blocks, the table decides.
A decode is the same with ONE position: it lands in the last block, or in a fresh block when position % 16 == 0.
animated: three ids leave the free list into the table; each logical block's positions fly into its physical block; slot_mapping is read off
